summary: Require fresh fully validated attribution probes rather than trusting receipts that may predate overlay changes or host validation.

replay.detail: No data replay; integrator version 12 invalidates prior attribution tree-cache identities.

compatibility.detail: Temporary probe namespaces retain the existing immutable build helper and current overlay inputs.

manual.detail: No additional rollout action beyond the integrator launcher repin.

recovery.detail: Probe outputs are removed after completion; previous served builds and existing probe artifacts are untouched.
